dct_description_sm: To create an interactive database and mapping application that illustrates where different types of land uses are proposed or occurring within the context of other past, present and reasonably foreseeable developments. The GIS mapping tool will be used to help inform the environmental assessment process regarding project proposals or developments within the Nunavut Settlement Area.
